description: The getTransactions method allows a seller to retrieve information about one or more of their monetary transactions (SALE, REFUND, CREDIT, etc.). Numerous input filters are available.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filters such as transactionDate, transactionType, transactionStatus, buyerUsername, orderId, etc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of transactions per page. Max 1000.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based position of the first transaction in results.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting (not yet available, defaults to descending transaction date).
